name: Barzil Sport Cafe & Grill

location.address: Sarv-e Gharbi Blvd, Sadaf St, corner of Azalia alley, Saadat Abad, Tehran

media.alt: Real photo from Barzil Sport Cafe & Grill's Instagram

description: A sport-cafe-grill and Saadat Abad institution: big breakfast bar in the morning, highly-rated burger nights after dark. Modern, energetic interior, slick service, open 8:00-midnight. The trade-off: loud and busy at night, and a grill first, specialty coffee second.
